analyst.summary: Groww (Billionbrains Garage Ventures) is India's largest broker by active clients, listed Nov-2025 at Rs100, now ~Rs207 (mkt cap ~Rs1.31 lakh cr). Q1 FY27 (out 15-Jul-2026): revenue +66% YoY to Rs1,501cr, PAT +94% YoY to Rs735cr, with market-share GAINS across MF-SIP, stock ADTO, equity derivatives, MTF and commodities even as the SEBI F&O-curb cycle cost the industry ~2mn active investors in H1 2025. Valuation is rich (~63x trailing / ~44x forward P/E) and ~50% of revenue is still F&O-derived, so the multiple has little cushion against a fresh regulatory move; MTF/commodity diversification (8% and rising) is the offsetting positive. No quant score exists yet -> Hold by default, and the fundamental read independently agrees.
